kickFile for macOS

1. Drag kickFile into Applications.
2. Open it. macOS says it can't check kickFile for malicious software,
   because kickFile isn't notarised by Apple yet. Click Done (or Cancel).
3. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down and click
   "Open Anyway" next to kickFile, then confirm.
4. When macOS asks to let kickFile find devices on your local network, click Allow.

You only do this once.
